document.title: 색상 이상 YK 자재 테스트 리포트 - BRS-201506
document.purpose: 색상이 다른 YK 자재의 사용 가능 여부 판단.

cn1.normalized_interpretation: YK 다른색 Short S-MG 평균 54.73 vs Normal 58.39 kgf(-6.27%); C-MG 42.69 vs 44.28(-3.59%); Yoke 151.13 vs 182.66(-17.26%). 모두 스펙(6, 70 kgf) 초과 PASS.

cn2.statement_from_report: Semi Yoke, Final SPK 낙하 모두 OK
cn2.normalized_interpretation: 각 n=10 YK 다른색·Normal 모두 0 NG.

cn3.statement_from_report: Function NG 32/374, 8.6%로 Normal 7%보다 높음. decap 결과 SM offset, coil deform, VP Dome+Coil separate가 주원인
cn3.normalized_interpretation: Function NG 8.56% vs Normal 7.02% = 1.22배, 동일 이벤트 21.8% 악화. 30 NG decap에서 SM offset 9, Coil Deform 5, Particle 5, VP Dome+Coil 4가 주원인. 500pcs 추가 테스트 후 결정.

h1.reason: 300pcs에서 동일 이벤트 function NG 21.8% 상대 증가, 작성자가 추가 시험 요청.

h2.check_item: 해당 yoke 로트로 조립 시 SM offset, Coil Deform 점검
h2.reason: 30 NG decap에서 SM offset 9/30, Coil Deform 5/30 우세 – yoke 표면 직접 영향보단 조립 동시 발생.

assumptions: Decap NG count는 sheet 2의 H 컬럼 합계 사용.
warnings: sheet 2 NG type별 세부표는 렌더에 일부만 잡혀 H열 합계만 추출.
log.decision_rationale: Tension/Vision/Drop은 PASS, Function NG는 21.8% 상대 악화. NG 주요인이 ass'y(SM offset, Coil Deform)로 yoke 색상보다 조립 변동성 가능성. 500pcs 재시험 필요.

document.title: YK different colour material test report - BRS-201506
document.purpose: Decide whether yoke material with abnormal colour is usable.

cn1.statement_from_report: YK+SM and YK+CM tension all OK
cn1.normalized_interpretation: YK diff colour Short S-MG AVG 54.73 vs Normal 58.39 kgf (-6.27%); C-MG 42.69 vs 44.28 (-3.59%); Yoke 151.13 vs 182.66 (-17.26%). All far above 6/70 kgf spec → PASS.

cn2.statement_from_report: Semi Yoke and Final SPK drop test all OK
cn2.normalized_interpretation: n=10 each; YK diff colour and Normal both 0 NG.

cn3.statement_from_report: Function NG 32/374pcs (8.6%) higher than Normal 7%; decap reasons SM offset, coil deform, VP Dome+Coil separate
cn3.normalized_interpretation: Function NG 8.56% vs Normal 7.02% = 1.22x, 21.8% worse same-event. 30-NG decap dominated by SM offset 9, Coil Deform 5, Particle 5, VP Dome+Coil 4. Need 500pcs 2nd test.

h1.reason: 300pcs showed +21.8% relative function NG vs same-event normal; author requested 2nd test.

h2.check_item: Check SM offset and Coil Deform during ass'y with this yoke lot
h2.reason: 30 NG decap: SM offset 9, Coil Deform 5 dominate – suggests ass'y variation rather than yoke surface.

assumptions: Tension AVG taken from row 35 averaged over 12 samples.
Decap NG counts from H-column totals on sheet 2.
warnings: Sheet 2 per-type detail tables only partially rendered; only H-column totals captured.
log.decision_rationale: Tension/Vision/Drop PASS, Function NG +21.8% relative; dominant NG modes are ass'y items (SM offset, Coil Deform). Re-test at 500pcs.

document.purpose: Quyết định có dùng được Yoke khác màu hay không.

cn2.statement_from_report: Drop test Semi Yoke và Final đều OK
